data.gender_notes: Lita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'litus', meaning 'little' or 'small'. In Christian contexts, Lita can be interpreted as a diminutive form of names like Elizabeth or Agnes, emphasizing the concept of 'little one of God'. The name Lita carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lita usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lita total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_greek.name: Λίτα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λίτα πιθανόν να προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις που σχετίζονται με την έννοια του 'σύντομος' ή 'πολύτιμος'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την πνευματική σύνδεση με το Θεό και την πολύτιμη σχέση με την θρησκεία.

in_latin.name: Lita
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lita potest significare 'brevitas' vel 'pretium'. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen potest referri ad brevem et pretiosam vitam sanctorum vel personarum biblicarum, quae fuerunt breves in vita sed magna in virtutibus.
